create.name: Kimi Recor
create.bio:
Kimi Recor is a Berlin musician and sound artist who guides breathwork, deep listening and sonic meditation in English. She has spent around twenty-five years singing, producing and performing, and sound slowly turned from a way of making art into a way of helping people settle, connect and create. She trained in Conscious Connected Breath with Rob Starbuck, studied sound facilitation at the Soundbath Center in Los Angeles and the Sounding Arts programme of the Berlin School of Sound, and keeps a long practice of deep listening in the tradition of Pauline Oliveros.

Her sessions mix gongs, bowls, tuning forks and voice with loop stations, synths and field recordings, and she likes to coax people back into using their own voices. She makes a point of welcoming people with no musical or spiritual background. In Berlin she runs small facilitator trainings in sound and in breathwork, offers one-to-one mentorships from her studio in Spandau, and leads weekly classes and community gong events; online she has a self-paced course on building ambient soundscapes for meditation. With Yasemin Vollmond she co-founded The Portal, which stages experimental listening events in old churches and similar spaces.

courses.title: The Frequency Facilitator Training
courses.description: A small-group training in sonic meditation and deep listening for up to six people: four prerecorded online modules followed by two days in person in a Kreuzberg loft. Participants work with gongs, bowls, tuning forks, voice and electronics, and learn to design and hold their own sound journeys.
courses.price: €500 EUR early bird (until 1 Nov), €600 EUR after, plus VAT

courses.title: Breathwork Facilitator Training
courses.description: Six recorded evening workshops online and a weekend in person in Neukölln, for up to fifteen people, taught in English. It covers Conscious Connected Breathing and other techniques, the basics of breath physiology, using sound in sessions, facilitation skills, ethics and setting up a practice.
courses.price: €555 EUR early bird, €700 EUR after 15 Jan, plus VAT

courses.title: Electronic Sonic Rituals for Beginners
courses.description: A self-paced online course for complete beginners on making ambient and electronic soundscapes for meditation in GarageBand. It moves from first recordings and field sounds to building chosen tones into a piece and shaping a personal sound ritual.
courses.price: €222, €333 or €444 EUR sliding scale, plus VAT

courses.title: Frequency Facilitator Mentorship
courses.description: A one-to-one mentorship for people who want to work with sound in their own way: the online modules of the facilitator training, two calls and a full day of practice at Kimi's studio in Spandau. One place is offered each month.

courses.title: Private Bookings
courses.description: Breathwork, deep listening and sonic meditation sessions designed for a group, team, retreat or event, in Berlin or elsewhere. Each booking is quoted by project.
